'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Wad Madani]]
***The [[Rapid Support Forces]] launch a second assault and capture [[Wad Madani]], the capital of [[Gezira State]], after being repelled by the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] yesterday. [https://sudantribune.com/article280465/ (''Sudan Tribune'')] [https://sudantribune.com/article280478/ (''Sudan Tribune 2'')]
***The RSF capture the city of [[Rufaa (city)|Rufaa]], north of Wad Madani. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231218-paramilitaries-seize-town-as-fighting-rages-in-sudan-s-second-city (France 24)]
***The [[International Organization for Migration]] say at least 250,000 people have fled Gezira State since the start of hostilities in the region. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/world/article-at-least-250000-flee-fighting-in-sudans-el-gezira-state-says/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
*[[Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)|Yemeni Crisis]]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***A [[Norway|Norwegian]]-owned [[tanker (ship)|tanker]] en route to [[Réunion]],  M/V ''Swan Atlantic'', is attacked in the [[Red Sea]]. The owner of the ship saying that it was hit by an "unidentified object" that struck its port side causing a small fire but no injuries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/ukmto-ambrey-report-possible-explosion-south-yemens-port-mokha-2023-12-18/ (Reuters)]
***[[United Kingdom|British]] [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] [[petroleum|oil]] and [[natural gas|gas]] company [[BP]] suspends all shipments through the Red Sea in response to an increase in [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] attacks on commercial vessels. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-67748605 (BBC News)]
***[[United States Secretary of Defense|U.S. Defense Secretary ]] [[Lloyd Austin]] announces a coalition of ten nations, called [[Operation Prosperity Guardian]], to enforce security in the Red Sea and [[Gulf of Aden]] amid Houthi attacks. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/12/18/politics/commercial-ships-red-sea-gulf-of-aden-houthi-attacks/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/lloyd-austin-ap-red-sea-bahrain-houthi-b2466225.html (''The Independent'')]

***The [[Royal Jordanian Air Force]] carries out [[airstrike]]s in southern [[Syria]] against [[drug gang]]s linked to the [[Politics of Syria|Syrian government]]. [https://apnews.com/article/jordan-syria-smugglers-captagon-airstrike-sweida-ad04317e67d53e439ce2b05f8b2fcb1c (AP)]
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[Allied Democratic Forces]] kill ten people in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Kyabandara]], [[Kamwenge District]], [[Western Region, Uganda|Western]] [[Uganda]]. [https://www.monitor.co.ug/uganda/news/national/10-killed-in-kamwenge-attack--4468728 (Daily Monitor)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Christianity in Malaysia]]
**The [[Department of Islamic Development Malaysia]] permits [[halal]]-certified bakeries in the [[Malaysia|country]] to include [[Christmas in Malaysia|Christmas]] [[Cake decorating|greetings on cakes]], overturning a previous directive that prohibited such messages. [https://www.thenews.com.pk/print/1139991-malaysia-oks-merry-christmas-on-halal-cakes (AFP via ''The News'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023–2024 Sundhnúkur eruptions]]
**The Sundhnúkur volcanic eruption occurs on the [[Southern Peninsula (Iceland)|Reykjanes Peninsula]] in [[Iceland]] after weeks of [[earthquake]]s prompting the evacuation of 4,000 people. The [[Icelandic Meteorological Office]] says that the risk of [[lava]] flowing toward the town of [[Grindavík]] is high. [https://www.ruv.is/english/2023-12-18-eruption-on-reykjanes-peninsula-399922 (RÚV)]
*[[2023 Jishishan earthquake]]
**At least 127 people are killed and over 720 others are injured by a magnitude 5.9 [[list of earthquakes in China|earthquake]] in [[Jishishan Bonan, Dongxiang and Salar Autonomous County|Jishishan]], [[Gansu]], [[China]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/china-earthquake-gansu-qinghai-death-toll-damage-3997306 (AFP via CNA)]
*At least 13 people are killed and at least 88 are injured by an [[explosion]] at an [[oil terminal]] in [[Conakry]], [[Guinea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/several-feared-killed-guinea-oil-terminal-blast-police-officer-2023-12-18/ (Reuters)]
*A major [[winter storm]] hits the [[Northeastern United States|Northeastern]] [[United States]], killing four people and causing [[flash flood warning]]s, flight cancellations and school closures. [https://apnews.com/article/severe-weather-northeast-64d2276c10ce2e7633ecb6df64f45d33 (AP)]
